articles.title: Gensler’s Adam Griff Joins JLL’s Nonprofit, Education and Government Practice
articles.narrative: Adam Griff, a veteran in architecture and strategic planning, has joined JLL as a managing director within its nonprofit, education, and government practice. Based in New York, Griff will focus on advising educational institutions and other mission-driven organizations on real estate and institutional strategies. This move comes as higher education faces significant restructuring, prompting institutions to re-evaluate how their campuses align with academic missions and financial sustainability. Griff's expertise is expected to enhance JLL's capacity to guide clients through these complex decisions, helping them identify new opportunities and maximize real estate asset value for long-term success.

people.name: David Carlos
people.title: Head of Nonprofit Practice, Tri-State Area

articles.title: Affinius Capital Provides $226M for Downtown Brooklyn Multifamily Building
articles.narrative: A joint venture between Lonicera Partners and Rabina has secured $226 million in bridge debt from Affinius Capital to refinance 55 Willoughby, a 43-story multifamily complex in Downtown Brooklyn. The financing will support the 295-unit property through its lease-up and stabilization phase, which is expected to conclude early next year. The property is described as a high-quality asset in a supply-constrained submarket, benefiting from strong lease-up momentum despite a volatile market.

data_points.notable_features: 43-story building with ground-floor retail space, offering studios, one-bedrooms, and two-bedrooms.
data_points.project_notes: Construction began in June 2023. Also known as House 55.

articles.title: Outpost Acquires Two IOS Facilities Near Shipping Corridors in New Jersey
articles.narrative: Outpost, an industrial outdoor storage (IOS) firm, has acquired two properties in Kearny and Newark, New Jersey, for $68.5 million. The nearly 15-acre acquisition, financed with a $52.2 million loan from Forbright Bank, expands Outpost's national IOS portfolio and will support nearby maritime ports and Newark Liberty International Airport. The firm noted that these properties are critical logistics assets in a supply-constrained market, with one being a stabilized, fully leased asset and the other offering immediate value-add opportunities.

data_points.notable_features: The Kearny facility at 76 Central Avenue includes two small office buildings and capacity for 234 shipping containers, 66 trailers, 28 tractors, and 54 cars; the Newark site at 2120 McCarter Highway spans 6.9 acres and can hold 163 55-foot trailers. Both are located near maritime ports and Newark Liberty International Airport.

articles.market_intelligence: Outpost is deploying a $1 billion fund to target investments in cities near major container ports with dense populations, little undeveloped land, and tight policies around new development. Demand for large, functional, properly zoned logistics facilities continues to grow while such sites are increasingly scarce.

articles.title: What Trio of Things Would Our 2026 Lenders Take to a Desert Island?
articles.narrative: This article presents a lighthearted thought experiment, asking several prominent commercial real estate lenders what three items they would bring if stranded on a desert island. The responses range from practical survival tools like a spear, knife, and fire starter, to comfort items such as a lounge chair, sparkling water, and a good book. Some lenders also highlighted their resourcefulness and even their continued focus on real estate, with one joking about financing the island itself and another envisioning building a new home to address the housing shortage.

articles.title: Commercial Real Estate Lenders Adapt to Higher-Forever Rates
articles.narrative: Commercial real estate lenders are adapting to a "higher-for-longer" interest rate environment, driven by persistent inflation and the Federal Reserve's hawkish stance. Lenders are becoming more defensive, selective, and focused on credit fundamentals, emphasizing strong cash flow, realistic lease-up assumptions, and clear paths to value creation. This shift involves rigorous underwriting, increased scenario analysis, and a preference for sponsors with proven track records and significant equity contributions, particularly in resilient sectors like industrial, higher-end residential, and hospitality.

articles.title: Walker & Dunlop Arranges $117.3M Refinancing of Texas Apartment Portfolio
articles.narrative: Walker & Dunlop has arranged $117.3 million in refinancing for a portfolio of three apartment communities totaling 960 units across Texas. The portfolio includes the 312-unit Austin Avenue in Georgetown, the 312-unit Aven Ridge in Leander, and the 336-unit Latitude Magnolia in Aubrey. The floating-rate, interest-only loans were provided by Benefit Street Partners to an undisclosed institutional investment group.

data_points.notable_features: The Austin-area communities were built in 2021 and 2022, offering one-, two-, and three-bedroom units, with Austin Avenue also including studio apartments. Latitude Magnolia was completed in 2021 and offers one- and two-bedroom units.

articles.title: Freehill Breaks Ground on 809,220 SF Build-to-Suit Industrial Project in Northwest Houston
articles.narrative: Freehill Co. has commenced construction on an 809,220-square-foot industrial project in northwest Houston, representing Phase I of the larger Fairbanks Landing development. This initial phase is a build-to-suit facility for Power Electronics, a manufacturer of solar inverters and EV chargers, and is expected to be completed in the third quarter of next year. Phase II will add two speculative buildings totaling 834,720 square feet, slated for delivery in late 2027.

data_points.notable_features: Build-to-suit for a manufacturer of solar inverters and EV chargers.
data_points.project_notes: Phase I consists of two buildings. Phase II will comprise two additional buildings totaling 834,720 square feet, developed on a speculative basis and slated for Q4 2027 delivery.

articles.title: Newmark Arranges $130M Sale of NorthBay Healthcare Portfolio in Northern California
articles.narrative: Newmark has brokered the sale of the NorthBay Health Medical Outpatient Building Collection, a portfolio of six fully leased healthcare buildings totaling 222,073 square feet in Fairfield and Vacaville, California. HealthCare Foundation acquired the portfolio for $130 million. The properties are fully occupied by a strong tenant mix, including medical outpatient facilities and office headquarters.

data_points.property_name: NorthBay Health Medical Outpatient Building Collection
data_points.notable_features: Portfolio includes five medical outpatient facilities and office headquarters.

articles.title: Colliers Secures $8.5M Sale of Industrial Building in Denver
articles.narrative: Colliers Denver Investment Services Group has facilitated the $8.5 million sale of a multi-tenant industrial building located at 4001 Holly Street in Denver. DMS Real Estate sold the 53,740-square-foot asset to Watumull Properties Corp. The property was fully leased to three tenants at the time of sale, offering a strong income stream to the new owner.

data_points.notable_features: Multi-tenant building demised into five small-bay units, each with dock-high and drive-in loading, and includes a fenced, paved and lighted outdoor storage yard.

articles.title: Levey Group to Develop 445,750 SF Industrial Project in Northeast Houston
articles.narrative: Levey Group is developing Levey East Belt, a 445,750-square-foot industrial project in northeast Houston. The development will feature a 270,400-square-foot front-load building and two rear-load buildings of 131,250 and 44,100 square feet. Permitting and approvals are expected to conclude in early 2027, with construction slated for 11 months, targeting an early 2028 delivery. Cushman & Wakefield is handling the leasing efforts for the project.

articles.title: Transwestern to manage more than 3 million-square-foot healthcare portfolio across 16 states
articles.narrative: Transwestern has been appointed by Spring Creek Healthcare Properties to manage a 3.1 million-square-foot healthcare real estate portfolio. The portfolio comprises 47 medical outpatient buildings located across 16 states, including key markets such as Southern California, Phoenix, Denver, Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, San Antonio, Tampa Bay, and South Florida. Transwestern commenced its management responsibilities on October 1, 2026.

articles.title: Kraus-Anderson wraps expansion of health clinic in Pine City
articles.narrative: Kraus-Anderson has completed a 36,383-square-foot expansion and renovation of the Welia Health Clinic in Pine City, Minnesota. The project, designed by DSGW Architecture, involved a 14,808-square-foot addition and a 21,485-square-foot renovation of the existing medical facility. Key enhancements include new exam rooms, expanded urgent care and rehabilitation services, an outdoor therapy space, and upgraded laboratory and imaging areas, all aimed at improving patient care and staff well-being.

data_points.address: 1425 Main St. North, Pine City, MN
data_points.notable_features: Includes 14,808-square-foot addition and 21,485-square-foot renovation; features redesigned floorplan, new exam rooms, expanded urgent care, rehabilitation services, outdoor therapy space, and enlarged parking.

articles.title: Northmarq negotiates sale of Robert Browning Apartments in Kansas City
articles.narrative: Bird Enterprises LLC has acquired The Robert Browning Apartments, a 64-unit mid-rise multifamily community in Kansas City, Missouri, from Bellada LLC. Northmarq's Kansas City Investment Sales team brokered the transaction for the seller. The property's historic architecture and prime location near the Country Club Plaza's ongoing redevelopment made it an attractive investment.

data_points.notable_features: Renovated studio apartment homes with historic charm, modern amenities, natural light, and Juliet balconies; designed by Nelle E. Peters; part of the Poet's District.

articles.title: The Boulder Group closes sale of Chase Bank location in Louisville
articles.narrative: The Boulder Group facilitated the sale of a single-tenant Chase Bank branch in Louisville, KY, for $2.8 million. The property, operating as a ground lease since 2004, was acquired by a Midwest-based investor from a private seller. The transaction's cap rate was below the retail net lease sector average, reflecting the strength of the investment-grade tenant and the favorable ground lease structure with zero landlord responsibilities and CPI-based rent escalations.

data_points.notable_features: Located in a dense retail corridor with convenient access to Interstates 264 and 64, and surrounded by national retailers and medical facilities. The lease includes CPI-based rent escalations every five years with no cap.
data_points.project_notes: The property is secured by a triple net ground lease expiring January 29, 2034, with two 10-year renewal options. The lease carries zero landlord responsibilities.

articles.market_intelligence: The Louisville MSA ranks 43rd in the United States by population size. The retail net lease sector average cap rate for Q2 2026 was 6.60%. Deposits at this Chase Bank branch exceeded $119,000,000 in 2025.

articles.title: Cross Ocean, Lincoln Buy 1M-SF Dallas Offices, Plan $100M Makeover
articles.narrative: Cross Ocean Partners and Lincoln have acquired The Colonnade, a three-tower, 1.08 million-square-foot office campus in Dallas, TX. The joint venture plans a $100 million repositioning of the asset, which was previously owned by Fortis Property Group and fell into receivership after a loan default. The renovation will introduce new amenities and upgrade existing facilities, with the first phase of improvements expected by 2027.

data_points.notable_features: Three-tower office campus located along the Dallas North Tollway.
data_points.project_notes: The property was previously owned by Fortis Property Group and entered receivership in 2024 after defaulting on a $223 million loan.

articles.title: Duke Buys Discounted Durham Office Building
articles.narrative: DUMAC, Duke University's investment arm, acquired Erwin Square Plaza, a 238,792-square-foot office building in Durham, NC, for $30 million. The property, which was last sold in 2015 for $57 million, is fully leased, with Duke University itself serving as the anchor tenant, occupying 80% of the space. The university recently extended its lease for 10 years, with renewal options, for various administrative and health system offices.

data_points.notable_features: Features a courtyard, fitness center, and four ground-floor restaurants.
data_points.project_notes: Seller previously acquired the property for $57 million in 2015.

articles.title: Colliers Arranges $71M Sale of Chicago Educational Facility
articles.narrative: Colliers facilitated the $70.6 million sale of a 102,000-square-foot educational facility in Chicago's Roosevelt Collection. The property, fully leased to the British International School of Chicago, South Loop, was acquired by W. P. Carey from EPR Properties. The transaction highlights strong investor interest in high-quality, mission-critical real estate with long-term lease structures and reputable operators.

data_points.property_name: British International School of Chicago, South Loop
data_points.notable_features: Purpose-built facility with modern academic, arts, and athletic facilities.
data_points.project_notes: Acquired in September 2026. Fully occupied under a long-term absolute net lease.

articles.title: TruAmerica Pays $120M for Perimeter Center Rental Community
articles.narrative: TruAmerica Multifamily has acquired Bricks at Perimeter Center, a 446-unit garden-style apartment community in Atlanta's Perimeter Center submarket, for $120 million from Clark Ventures. The new owner plans to implement a premium finish package across nearly all units, including quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and updated flooring and cabinetry. This acquisition expands TruAmerica's Atlanta portfolio and contributes to the firm's significant acquisition volume for the year.

data_points.project_notes: Seller Clark Ventures previously acquired the property for $69.5 million in 2016.

Kast Construction Names New CEO: The South Florida Deal Sheet
Golden Apartment Building Sells For $62M To Chicago Company
articles.narrative: Draper and Kramer, a Chicago-based firm, has acquired a 120-unit multifamily complex in Golden, Colorado, for $62 million. This transaction reflects a notable shift in the current multifamily market dynamics.

articles.title: New Opportunity Zones May Help Finish California Projects, Not Start Them
articles.narrative: This article suggests that Opportunity Zones are more effective in providing the final push for real estate projects nearing completion rather than initiating new developments. The author argues that while Opportunity Zones offer significant tax benefits, they are not sufficient to overcome major obstacles such as high construction costs, which often deter projects from breaking ground in the first place. The core argument is that these zones serve as a valuable accelerant for existing projects but do not fundamentally alter the economic viability of new, speculative ventures facing substantial upfront costs.

articles.title: Ceutical Laboratories To Move HQ To Lewisville: The DFW Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: Ceutical Laboratories Inc. has signed a long-term lease for over 33,000 square feet at Waters Ridge Tech Center II in Lewisville, Texas, relocating its headquarters to the new facility. This move signifies the company's strategic decision to establish its main operational base in a larger, dedicated space.

articles.title: Former Randolph Event Venue Planned For 200-Room Hotel, Theater
articles.narrative: Core Investments is planning to develop a 200-room hotel and dinner theater on the former site of Lombardo's function hall in Randolph. This project aims to transform the vacant property into a new hospitality and entertainment venue.

data_points.project_notes: Site was formerly home to Lombardo's function hall.
